decisions.reason: Requiring help labels on all interactive fields neither resolves nor changes the separate unresolved requirement for a grey visual discoverability cue.
The label-text rule can coexist with clearing a field placeholder on activation and does not change that activation behavior.
The source specifies labels for interactive fields but does not change their underlying editable-text representation or architecture.
Applying the label rule to interactive fields does not alter the calendar-dropdown method required for date selection.
The source requires labels to match first-step text but does not change the established Danish language or the recorded date and subject text values.
Interactive-field label wording is independent of the requirement to include customer theme colors.
The interactive-field label decision does not modify bullet sizing, alignment, balance, reference design, or color.
The source concerns interactive-field help-label content, not heading, title, image-caption, or table-caption typography.
The label-text and all-interactive-fields decision does not change legacy copy-paste layout or style-stability expectations.
Interactive-field labels do not alter Tab-based list indentation or hierarchy behavior.
The source decision does not affect containment or layout stability for pasted tables and columns.
